findings.summary: Light-theme CTA labels fail normal-text contrast.
findings.fix: Use darker CTA background or dark labels meeting4.5:1; verify18px bold labels against normal-text threshold.
findings.evidence: 14 mutually exclusive instances on 8/100 pages; example p:nth-child(2) > .cta, #ffffff on #44b78b=2.5:1; 2 measured color recipes; full raw evidence in evidence/axe.

findings.summary: Muted metadata and secondary text fail normal-text contrast.
findings.fix: Darken light-theme metadata tokens to meet4.5:1 on white and sidebar backgrounds, including author and RSS links.
findings.evidence: 812 mutually exclusive instances on 82/100 pages; example .outline, #859d94 on #ffffff=2.89:1; 4 measured color recipes; full raw evidence in evidence/axe.

findings.summary: Light-theme green body and sidebar links fail text contrast.
findings.fix: Darken shared --link-color to meet4.5:1 on white, #f8f8f8, #f1fff7 and tinted table rows and gray badge panels; verify all interaction states.
findings.evidence: 4574 mutually exclusive instances on 100/100 pages; example .link-readmore:nth-child(3), #20aa76 on #f8f8f8=2.79:1; 5 measured color recipes; full raw evidence in evidence/axe.

findings.summary: Light-theme footer headings and navigation links fail text contrast.
findings.fix: Darken the footer background or use a dark text color providing4.5:1; preserve visible link focus.
findings.evidence: 3000 mutually exclusive instances on 100/100 pages; example .col-learn-more > h3, #f1fff7 on #44b78b=2.42:1; 1 measured color recipes; full raw evidence in evidence/axe.

findings.summary: Footer credits and donor links fail text contrast.
findings.fix: Use a lighter footer-specific accent providing4.5:1 on the dark-green footer background.
findings.evidence: 567 mutually exclusive instances on 100/100 pages; example .thanks > li:nth-child(1) > span, #2b8c67 on #0c4b33=2.43:1; 1 measured color recipes; full raw evidence in evidence/axe.

findings.summary: Current-page desktop navigation link fails normal-text contrast.
findings.fix: Use a lighter selected-navigation foreground with4.5:1 contrast in both themes; keep a non-color current-page indicator.
findings.evidence: 98 mutually exclusive instances on 98/100 pages; example .active > a, #44b78b on #0c4b33=4.05:1; 1 measured color recipes; full raw evidence in evidence/axe.

findings.summary: Light-theme banner text fails large-text contrast.
findings.fix: Darken banner background or change foreground so large text achieves3:1 and smaller text4.5:1.
findings.evidence: 114 mutually exclusive instances on 99/100 pages; example section > .container > p, #c9f0dd on #44b78b=2.02:1; 2 measured color recipes; full raw evidence in evidence/axe.

findings.summary: Expand-all and collapse-all labels fail text contrast.
findings.fix: Use a darker label foreground meeting4.5:1 and implement these controls as keyboard-accessible buttons.
findings.evidence: 4 mutually exclusive instances on 2/100 pages; example .expandall, #cacfcd on #ffffff=1.57:1; 1 measured color recipes; full raw evidence in evidence/axe.

findings.summary: Additional text colors fail minimum contrast outside the shared palette groups.
findings.fix: Review the remaining measured foreground/background pairs and change text or backgrounds to meet4.5:1 for normal text and3:1 for large text.
findings.evidence: 137 mutually exclusive instances on 33/100 pages; example li:nth-child(1) > span, #2b8c67 on #0c4b33=2.43:1; 5 measured color recipes; full raw evidence in evidence/axe.

findings.summary: Sponsor section eyebrows fail normal-text contrast.
findings.fix: Darken light-theme sponsor accent text to meet4.5:1 against white and #f8f8f8 backgrounds.
findings.evidence: 22 mutually exclusive instances on 4/100 pages; example .sponsor-intro > .sponsor-eyebrow, #2b8c67 on #ffffff=4.15:1; 2 measured color recipes; full raw evidence in evidence/axe.

notes: 100 completed desktoplight files; 9342 color-contrast nodes partitioned without overlap. Components classified by selector first, then shared recipe when selector lacks an ancestor; ambiguous leftovers kept separate.
Risk scores are remediation prioritization, not WCAG conformance evidence.
